_notes.competitionIds: PL=Premier League, CL=Champions League, PD=La Liga, BL1=Bundesliga, SA=Serie A, FL1=Ligue 1, EC=Euros, WC=World Cup
_notes.teamNames: Team names must exactly match what football-data.org returns. Run the workflow once and inspect the Fetch Finished Matches output to confirm exact names.
_notes.postIds: Find WordPress post IDs in wp-admin: hover over Edit for a post and read the ?post= value in the URL, or use the REST API: /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?search=TeamName
_notes.wordpressAuth: Generate an Application Password at yoursite.com/wp-admin > Users > Your Profile > Application Passwords. Then base64-encode username:app_password (e.g. in terminal: echo -n 'admin:xxxx xxxx xxxx' | base64)
